events.title: Sports Card & Memorabilia Sale
events.summary: Free admission. Buy, sell, and trade sports cards and memorabilia. Door prizes and raffles through the day. Half Barrel Brewing beer for purchase (21+). College football on TV.
events.source: TrailSide Events PA Facebook, public event

events.title: 4th of July at TrailSide
events.summary: From 5:00 p.m. until fireworks. Food from Shoenberger’s Meat Market. Live music by the 7th & Mahoning duo. Craft beer from Half Barrel Brewing. Cocktails with Eight Oaks and Stateside Spirits.
events.source: Public Facebook graphic. The graphic did not print a year; this site files it as a past highlight.

events.title: Live music nights
events.summary: The duo has been promoted playing at the house. No separate public date was printed beyond the 4th of July celebration, so this stays a past highlight rather than an upcoming night.

events.title: Grand opening ribbon cutting
events.hosts: TrailSide Events PA and the Carbon County Chamber
events.summary: 6–8 p.m. Bookings opened after this evening.
